ATS.dock.name: Bar docking
ATS.dock.hint: Sticks the bar to a screen edge; along that edge it anchors to a marker (start / center / end), set as you drag. « Free » = free drag & drop. Orientation is independent (setting below + ↻ button). Tip: several bars on the same edge line up side by side, never on top of each other.
ATS.orient.name: Bar orientation
ATS.orient.hint: Horizontal or vertical, independent of the docking edge. Also available via the bar's ↻ button.
ATS.panel.template.title: Template Bar · Settings
ATS.panel.combat.title: Combat Tracker · Settings
ATS.panel.token.title: Token Action Bar · Settings
ATS.menu.template.label: Template Bar
ATS.menu.template.hint: Docking and button size of the template bar.
ATS.menu.combat.label: Combat Tracker
ATS.menu.combat.hint: Docking, images, sizes and automations of the combat overlay.
ATS.menu.token.label: Token Action Bar
ATS.menu.token.hint: Docking, contents (weapons, features, spells) and display of the bar.
ATS.menu.hide.name: Hiding · Interface, tabs and bars
ATS.menu.hide.label: Configure hiding
ATS.menu.hide.hint: Choose, per audience (GM, table screen « TV », other players), which elements to hide: HUD elements, sidebar tabs and suite bars. The GM controls every screen.
ATS.settings.dockMargin.name: Bars · Screen docking margin (px)
ATS.settings.dockMargin.hint: Gap between a docked bar and the screen edge. 0 = flush with the edge.
ATS.settings.templateButtonSize.name: Button size (px)
ATS.settings.templateButtonSize.hint: Size of the template bar buttons.
ATS.settings.combatCurrentInline.name: Current shown in the list
ATS.settings.combatCurrentInline.hint: The combatant on their turn grows IN PLACE within the list, with floating targets to its right. Disabled: legacy display — current portrait and targets grouped in a right-hand column.
ATS.settings.showImages.name: Show portraits
ATS.settings.showImages.hint: Rail with combatant images (creature / character). Disabled: compact badges with initials.
ATS.settings.imageMode.name: Combatant image (list)
ATS.settings.imageMode.hint: List / rail thumbnails: actor sheet portrait or image of the token placed on the scene.
ATS.settings.featuredImageMode.name: Current and targets image
ATS.settings.featuredImageMode.hint: Large portrait of the current combatant and targets: actor sheet portrait or token image. Independent of the list thumbnail setting.
ATS.settings.hideInitInCombat.name: Hide initiative during combat
ATS.settings.hideInitInCombat.hint: Initiative is only useful during setup: it is hidden once combat starts (re-editable via the ⋮ options button). Disabled: small number in the thumbnail corner. Table-wide setting (GM).
ATS.settings.showNextButton.name: Show the button row by default
ATS.settings.showNextButton.hint: In combat, expands the GM action row by default (previous / next turn · end combat · preparation) under the round. The triangle on the round line collapses/expands it at any time. Off by default: the « . » and « , » shortcuts are enough. GM-only setting.
ATS.settings.rowSize.name: Rail thumbnail diameter (px)
ATS.settings.rowSize.hint: Diameter of the round combatant thumbnails in the rail.
ATS.settings.currentImageSize.name: Current combatant portrait size (px)
ATS.settings.currentImageSize.hint: Side of the large square portrait of the current combatant (and targets). Table-wide setting (also affects the players' view).
ATS.settings.autoControlToken.name: Select the current combatant's token
ATS.settings.autoControlToken.hint: On each turn change, selects the current combatant's token on the scene (for the user who owns it).
ATS.settings.panCameraGm.name: Pan camera — GM screen
ATS.settings.panCameraGm.hint: On each turn change, centers the view on the current token on the GM's screen.
ATS.settings.panCameraTv.name: Pan camera — table screen (TV)
ATS.settings.panCameraTv.hint: On each turn change, centers the view on the current token on the shared table screen (the player designated by « TV user »).
ATS.settings.panCameraOthers.name: Pan camera — other players
ATS.settings.panCameraOthers.hint: On each turn change, centers the view on the current token on the other players' screens.
ATS.settings.tokenButtonSize.name: Button size (px)
ATS.settings.tokenButtonSize.hint: Size of the item icons in the bar.
ATS.settings.includeInventory.name: Show weapons
ATS.settings.onlyEquippedWeapons.name: Equipped weapons only
ATS.settings.includeFeatures.name: Show features
ATS.settings.includeFeatures.hint: Genuinely actionable feats (real effect, resource or charge consumption), with a charge counter.
ATS.settings.includeSpells.name: Show spells
ATS.settings.includeSpells.hint: Cantrips (level 0) then spells grouped by level, with remaining / total slots.
ATS.settings.showGroupLabels.name: Show group headers
ATS.settings.showGroupLabels.hint: Thin row of section labels (Weapons, Features, Cantrips, L1…) and slot counters, above the icons.
ATS.settings.dedupeByName.name: Hide duplicates
ATS.settings.dedupeByName.hint: Hides items with the same name (keeps the first).
ATS.settings.alwaysShowFeatureNames.name: Always-shown « reminder » features
ATS.settings.alwaysShowFeatureNames.hint: Feature names always shown even without a mechanical effect (comma-separated). Substring match, case-insensitive.
ATS.keybind.nextTurn.name: Combat: next turn
ATS.keybind.prevTurn.name: Combat: previous turn
ATS.keybind.prevTurn.hint: Goes back to the previous combatant.
ATS.keybind.focusHp.name: Edit the selected token's HP
ATS.keybind.focusHp.hint: In combat: places the cursor in the target panel's HP field. Out of combat: opens a small HP field over the selected (or targeted) token. Enter « 8 » (damage) or « +8 » (healing), then Enter.
ATS.keybind.control.hint: Activates this scene control (switches the active column), like clicking it on the controls bar.
ATS.keybind.control.tokens.name: Control: Tokens
ATS.keybind.control.tiles.name: Control: Tiles
ATS.keybind.control.drawings.name: Control: Drawings
ATS.keybind.control.walls.name: Control: Walls
ATS.keybind.control.lighting.name: Control: Lighting
ATS.keybind.control.sounds.name: Control: Ambient sounds
ATS.keybind.control.regions.name: Control: Regions
ATS.keybind.control.notes.name: Control: Journal notes
ATS.keybind.templateMode.name: Template mode (draw a spell template)
ATS.keybind.templateMode.hint: Activates the Regions control's template mode (dnd5e) with the circle shape, then draw on the scene. Same as clicking a shape on the template bar.
ATS.keybind.teleportToken.name: Teleport selected tokens (GM)
ATS.keybind.teleportToken.hint: Hold this key then click on the scene: the selected tokens teleport instantly to that spot, with no path or animation. Multiple tokens keep their formation.
ATS.teleport.noToken: Teleport: select one or more tokens first.
ATS.template.label: Templates
ATS.template.modeMissing: Template mode (Regions → templateMode) not found. This feature requires dnd5e 5.x on Foundry v13+.
ATS.template.emanationReady: Emanation — attached to the selected token
ATS.template.emanationPickOne: Select exactly ONE token to attach the emanation.
ATS.template.regionsUnavailable: « Regions » control unavailable on this scene.
ATS.combat.noTarget: No target: target a token (T) or select it.
ATS.token.wrongSystem: This feature targets the dnd5e system (current system: {system}).
ATS.token.slotTooltip: Remaining / total slots at this level
ATS.panel.rolls.title: Rolls Bar · Settings
ATS.menu.rolls.label: Rolls Bar
ATS.menu.rolls.hint: Docking and display of the rolls bar (attacks and damage).
ATS.settings.rollsSkipDialog.name: Skip the roll configuration dialog
ATS.settings.rollsSkipDialog.hint: Attack and damage rolls fire immediately, bypassing dnd5e's roll configuration window. Advantage / disadvantage stay driven by the system's modifier keys (click = normal, Alt = advantage, Ctrl = disadvantage).
ATS.settings.rollsMaxEntries.name: Number of rolls kept
ATS.settings.rollsMaxEntries.hint: How many recent rolls the bar stacks before dropping the oldest.
ATS.rolls.modeSet.advantage: Set to advantage (rolls a 2nd d20 if needed)
ATS.rolls.modeSet.disadvantage: Set to disadvantage (rolls a 2nd d20 if needed)
ATS.rolls.rollDamageHint: Roll damage (critical auto on a natural 20)
ATS.rolls.rollCritHint: Roll critical damage (dice doubled, not the bonus)
ATS.rolls.noActivity: Source activity not found — roll damage from the chat card.
ATS.rolls.noTarget: No target: target tokens (T) or select them.
ATS.panel.controls.title: Control Bar · Settings
ATS.menu.controls.label: Control Bar
ATS.menu.controls.hint: Floating replica of Foundry's native scene controls, dockable like the suite's other bars.
ATS.settings.controlsButtonSize.name: Button size (px)
ATS.settings.controlsButtonSize.hint: Size of the control bar buttons.
ATS.controls.label: Controls
ATS.panel.scene.title: Scene Bar · Settings
ATS.menu.scene.label: Scene Bar
ATS.menu.scene.hint: Floating replica of Foundry's native scene navigation, dockable like the suite's other bars.
ATS.settings.sceneButtonSize.name: Tab height (px)
ATS.settings.sceneButtonSize.hint: Height and text size of the scene bar tabs.
ATS.scene.label: Scenes
ATS.hide.hint: Check what you want to HIDE, per audience. GM = your screen; TV = the table screen (player designated below); Others = the other players. Applied live.
ATS.hide.mirror: Table mode (180° mirror copy on the TV screen)
